description: Dynamic tree edge replacement with rooted-side range addition and sum using a lazy Euler-tour treap.

source.title: Library Checker: Dynamic Tree Subtree Add Subtree Sum
source.reference: Dynamic Tree Subtree Add Subtree Sum task
source.algorithm_attribution: Euler-tour sequence with per-vertex markers and marker-only lazy range addition
source.implementation_status: clean-room bounded profile; operation semantics only

event_records.0: [0,u,v,w,x] replaces present edge (u,v) by (w,x), preserving a tree
event_records.1: [1,v,p,delta,0] adds delta to the component side of v after removing adjacent edge (v,p)
event_records.2: [2,v,p,0,0] returns the sum on that same component side

input.topology_preconditions: Initial edges form a tree; replacements preserve a tree; update and query parent vertices are adjacent.

output.encoding: one signed 64-bit little-endian sum per query, in event order

workspace.meaning: Fixed Euler-tour treap nodes, edge-token matrix, topology-validation adjacency, and staged answers.

contract.operation: Maintain a weighted tree under edge replacement, add a value to one edge-oriented component, and query that component sum.
contract.algorithm: Implicit randomized Euler-tour treap; each vertex has one weighted marker and each edge has two directed zero-weight tokens. A component side is the marker range between an edge's directed tokens.
contract.complexity: Expected O(log(N+Q)) per treap event plus O(N^2+NQ) bounded topology preflight, and O(N+Q) bounded storage.
contract.error_precedence: Input framing and event fields are validated before topology; full topology validation precedes output-capacity checks.
